TS.name: Turnstile device
TS.description: Turnstile device is a device that allows or denies passage of people into metro or paid restroom. It can be unlocked by payment with coin or banknote.

PU.name: Payment unit
PU.description: Payment unit is a sub-FA of turnstile device that handles payment with coin or banknote. It can be in one of two sub-FAs: BPU (Banknote Payment Process) or CPU (Coin Payment Process).

C.name: Check of banknote
C.description: Checks if a banknote is an official and can be used as payment element

A.name: Acceptance of banknote
A.description: Accept a real banknote and save it in internal tresor

BR.bc$.name: Banknote candidate
BR.bc$.description: Some artifact is putted in banknote slot. This signal contains data with this artifact

BC.p$.name: Banknote is ok
BC.p$.description: Banknote checker send this signal, when banknote is checked and can be used as payment element. This signal contains data with this banknote

BC.r$.name: Banknote is not ok (rejected)
BC.r$.description: Banknote checker send this signal, when banknote is checked and can't be used as payment element. This signal contains data with this banknote

BA.c$.name: Change is needed
BA.c$.description: Banknote Acceptor sends this signal when the accepted banknote requires change. Data contains the change value.

BA.n.name: Change is not needed
BA.n.description: Banknote Acceptor sends this signal when the accepted banknote requires no change.

BC.c$.name: Check banknote
BC.c$.description: Command to banknote checker with data with banknote for checking

BA.a$.name: Accept banknote
BA.a$.description: Command to banknote acceptor with data with banknote for acceptance

CW.name: Check of weight of coin
CW.description: Checks if a weight of a coin is in accepted interval

CF.name: Check of form of coin
CF.description: Checks if a form of coin is accepted

A.name: Aceceptance of coin
A.description: Accept a real coin and save it in internal tresor

CR.cc$.name: Coin candidate
CR.cc$.description: Some artifact is putted in coin slot. This signal contains data with this artifact

CC.p$.name: Coin is ok
CC.p$.description: Coin checker send this signal, when coin is checked and can be used as payment element. This signal contains data with this coin

CC.r$.name: Coin is not ok (rejected)
CC.r$.description: Coin checker send this signal, when coin is checked and can't be used as payment element. This signal contains data with this coin

CA.c$.name: Change is needed
CA.c$.description: Coin Acceptor sends this signal when the accepted coin requires change. Data contains the change value.

CA.n.name: Change is not needed
CA.n.description: Coin Acceptor sends this signal when the accepted coin requires no change.

CC.cw$.name: Check coin weight
CC.cw$.description: Command to Coin Checker to validate the weight of the coin candidate. Data contains the coin artifact.

CC.cf$.name: Check coin form
CC.cf$.description: Command to Coin Checker to validate the form/shape of the coin candidate. Data contains the coin artifact.

CA.a$.name: Accept coin
CA.a$.description: Command to Coin Acceptor to accept the validated coin. Data contains the coin artifact.

ReB.name: Reject bin
ReB.description: Rejection of false artifacts (coin or banknote) and send them to reject box

CCM.name: Currency change machine
CCM.description: Currency change machine is a sub-FA of turnstile device that handles making change for accepted banknotes or coins.

CH.c$.name: Make change
CH.c$.description: Command to the Changer to dispense change. Data contains the change amount copied from the triggering signal.

L.name: Locked
L.description: Turnstile is locked and doesn't let someone into the metro or a paid restroom

U.name: Unlocked
U.description: Turnstile is unlocked and let someone into the metro or a paid restroom

TS.s.name: System start
TS.s.description: SFSM initialization signal that transitions the turnstile into its initial Locked state.

TS.to.name: Turnstile timeout
TS.to.description: Turnstile is in unlocked state too long and should be locked

TS.ps.name: Passage
TS.ps.description: Someone pass through turnstile and it should be locked

TS.l.name: Lock turnstile
TS.l.description: Command to turnstile to lock itself

TS.ut.name: Unlock turnstile
TS.ut.description: Command to turnstile to unlock itself ans start a timeout for waiting of passage
